title: QR Code system implemented for fuel distribution
byline: The QR Code system for vehicles will be implemented for fuel distribution with effect from 6.00 am today (Sunday, 15 March), Sri Lanka’s Energy Ministry announced.

title: Fairly heavy showers expected in parts of the island
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Uva provinces and in Galle, Matara, Mannar and Anuradhapura districts after 2.00 pm, today (15), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: US, China economic chiefs meet in Paris to clear path to Trump-Xi summit
byline: Top U.S. and Chinese economic officials are set to launch a new round of talks in Paris on Sunday to iron out kinks in their trade truce and clear a smooth path for U.S. President Donald Trump’s trip to Beijing to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping at the end of March.

title: Trump says Iran is ready to negotiate a ceasefire but he’s not ready to make a deal
byline: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he’s not ready to make a deal to end the war with Iran despite the country’s willingness to do so “because the terms aren’t good enough yet,” but declined to say what those terms would be.

title: Illegal assets worth Rs. 55.5 million linked to drug trafficker frozen
byline: The Illegal Assets Investigation Division has frozen property allegedly acquired through illegal earnings by a suspected drug trafficker.

title: QR code for fuel: Issues regarding vehicle or number changes being resolved
byline: The Director General of Government Information has announced that individuals who previously obtained QR codes for fuel purchases will be able to update their codes without difficulty if they continue to use the same vehicle and telephone number.

title: Govt to issue fuel to private buses through SLTB depots
byline: The Ministry of Energy says that fuel will be issued to private passenger transport buses through depots belonging to the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB).

title: IRGC warns attacks on US banks in Gulf region will expand if more Iranian banks are targeted
byline: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) on Saturday (local time) warned that attacks on American bank branches operating in the Gulf region could expand if further strikes by the US and Israel target Iranian banking infrastructure, according to Press TV.

title: Hamas calls on Iran not to target neighboring countries but affirms its right to self-defence
byline: The Palestinian Iran-aligned militant group Hamas has called on Iran to not target neighbouring countries, while still reaffirming Tehran’s right to respond to the U.S.-Israeli attacks.

title: Police officers deployed to control traffic near filling stations
byline: Police officers have been deployed near filling stations to manage traffic congestion following the reintroduction of the QR code system for fuel distribution, the Deputy Inspector General (DIG) in charge of Traffic and Road Safety Range, W.P.J. Senadheera has stated.

title: Fuel will not be dispensed into cans and bottles: Filling Station Owners
byline: The distribution of fuel under the QR code system has officially commenced across the island, the Chairman of the Lanka Filling Station Owners Association, Kumara Rajapaksha stated.

title: “If he’s alive...”: Iran vows to “pursue, kill” Netanyahu amid death rumours
byline: Iran has vowed to “pursue and kill” Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as it continued strikes on Israel on the 16th day of the war in the Middle East.

title: Mahara court issues warrant against MP Asoka Ranwala over road accident case
byline: The Mahara Magistrate’s Court has issued a warrant for the arrest of National People’s Power (NPP) Member of Parliament, Asoka Ranwala.

title: Iran arrests 20 suspected Israeli spies
byline: Iranian law enforcement authorities have arrested 20 people in the city of Urmia, the administrative center of West Azerbaijan Province, on suspicion of espionage and collaboration with Israeli intelligence, Tasnim News Agency reports.

title: Americans urged to leave 14 countries across Middle East
byline: The US embassy in Baghdad has issued a fresh warning for its citizens to leave Iraq after a missile hit the embassy building earlier on Saturday.

title: Water supply disrupted in several areas in Kalutara
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced that water supply to several areas in Kalutara has been disrupted due to a breakdown in the main water supply line from Kethhena to Kalutara.

title: No fuel shortage despite QR code system, says CPC
byline: No fuel shortage has emerged in the country despite the implementation of the QR code system for fuel distribution, the Managing Director of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC), Mayura Neththikumarage stated.

title: Meta planning sweeping layoffs as AI costs mount
byline: Meta is planning sweeping layoffs that could affect 20% or more of the company, three sources familiar with the matter told Reuters, as Meta seeks to offset costly artificial intelligence infrastructure bets and prepare for greater efficiency brought about by AI-assisted workers.

title: Fuelpass registration now available for unregistered and transferred vehicles
byline: The registration process under the QR code system has now been restored for new vehicles, vehicles that were transferred to a new owner and previously unregistered vehicles, authorities have confirmed.

title: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei in good health, Iran FM says
byline: The health of Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is good, Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said in an interview with Al Araby Al Jadeed, APA reports.

title: QR code process to obtain fuel quotas through National Fuel Pass system fully restored: Govt
byline: The QR code process to obtain fuel quotas through the National Fuel Pass system has now been fully restored and is currently operating normally, the Ministry of Digital Economy has announced.

title: All PSC-approved 2026 transfers to take effect on April 2
byline: All transfers approved for the year 2026 must be implemented starting from April 2, the Public Service Commission (PSC) has announced.

title: Court issues warrant against MP Asoka Ranwala over road accident case
byline: The Mahara Magistrate’s Court has issued a warrant for the arrest of National People’s Power (NPP) Member of Parliament, Asoka Ranwala.

title: Sri Lanka calls for immediate de-escalation of tensions in Middle East
byline: Sri Lanka is deeply concerned by the rapidly escalating situation in the Middle East and West Asia, which poses a direct threat to the civilian population, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said in a statement.

title: Emergency measures discussed to maintain health, agriculture and education services in Sri Lanka
byline: Amid the ongoing wartime situation in the Middle East, the President’s Office today (15) held a meeting with secretaries of relevant ministries and heads of institutions to discuss challenges encountered in maintaining essential public services.

title: More than 100 hospitalised in Israel over past 24 hours
byline: The Israeli health ministry has confirmed that 108 people have been taken to hospital with injuries in the past 24 hours.

title: QR fuel allocations insufficient for medical services: GMOA
byline: The fuel allocations proposed under the QR code system are insufficient, the Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) has stated.

title: Be mindful of accuracy of information before sharing it on social media: PM Harini
byline: The weakening of public trust in information disseminated through the media is extremely dangerous for a society, and therefore people must be mindful of the truthfulness of information before sharing it on social media, according to Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya.

title: Possible increase in prices of imported goods amid Middle East conflict – Dy Minister
byline: Deputy Minister of Trade RM Jayawardena has warned that Sri Lanka may experience a rise in the prices of imported goods due to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East and disruptions in fuel transportation.

title: Oil poised for further gains as Middle East conflict threatens export facilities
byline: Oil prices could extend gains at Monday’s open as the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran entered a third week, putting oil infrastructure at risk and keeping the Strait of Hormuz shut in the world’s largest supply disruption.

title: Average US gas prices reach $3.70 — up almost 24% since start of Iran war
byline: US gas prices reached an average of $3.70 a gallon today, according to AAA, a near 24% increase since the war in Iran began on February 28.

title: President reviews energy supply measures amid Middle East conflict
byline: A special discussion has been held at the President’s Office this afternoon (15) on the next steps to be taken amid the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several provinces and districts
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern and North-western provinces and in THE Monaragala, Mannar, Anuradhapura and Vavuniya districts.

title: Israel to continue Iran campaign for at least three more weeks
byline: The Israeli military is planning at least three more weeks of its campaign against Iran with “thousands of targets” remaining, Israel Defense Forces (IDF) military spokesperson told CNN Sunday.

title: Navy intercepts another multi-day fishing vessel carrying suspected narcotics
byline: Five suspects have been taken into custody by the Sri Lanka Navy along with a local multi-day fishing vessel that was transporting a stock of sacks suspected to contain narcotics.

title: No shortage of fuel expected until end of next month, fuel to be issued with police supervision – CPC
byline: Fuel will only be distributed through the QR code system at filling stations from now on, with the assistance and supervision of police, the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) has announced.

title: New curriculum will be introduced for preschools next year: PM Harini
byline: A new curriculum will be introduced for preschools in 2027, while steps will also be taken to train teachers accordingly and to regulate preschools through a regulatory authority, the Prime Minister, Dr. Harini Amarasuriya stated.

title: Four more members of Iran’s women’s soccer team withdraw Australia asylum claims
byline: Four more members of the Iranian women’s soccer squad withdrew their asylum requests to the Australian government after facing pressure from Tehran, two sources close to the team have said.

title: Pope Leo calls for ceasefire in Middle East amid ‘horrific violence of war’
byline: Pope Leo XIV has called for a ceasefire in the Middle East conflict as Israel and Iran continue to trade blows and the death toll across the region mounts.

title: Iran denies asking for ceasefire or talks after Trump claims it wants deal to end war
byline: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Iran was not interested in talks with the United States, pushing back on US President Donald Trump’s stance that Tehran wants a deal to end the war.

title: India and Sri Lanka’s ports should be complementary rather than competitive: Senasinghe
byline: Highlighting the strategic importance of the Indian Ocean, Sri Lankan Member of Parliament Sujeewa Senasinghe delivered a keynote address at the NXT Conclave 2026 in new Delhi on the future of sea trade and transshipment between India and Sri Lanka.

title: Lebanon says 850 killed in two weeks of Israel-Hezbollah war
byline: Lebanon’s health ministry said on Sunday that Israeli attacks have killed 850 people in the country during two weeks of war between Israel and Hezbollah.
